 MELBOURNE, Fla., Sept. 8, 2026 — L3Harris Technologies (NYSE: LHX) has been selected by the U.S. Navy to deliver VAMPIRE™ counter-unmanned systems (C-UxS) in support of the U.S.’ growing integrated C-UxS defense architecture.
 The VAMPIRE system is a self-contained weapons solution that delivers advanced reconnaissance and precision strike against drones and remotely piloted platforms across domains. 
 “VAMPIRE is a flexible and effective system that meets the unique requirements of the U.S. Navy for littoral C-UxS defense,” said Tony Calderon, President, Targeting & Sensor Systems, Communications & Spectrum Dominance, L3Harris. “We’re engineering new capabilities to adapt to our customers’ missions and ruggedizing VAMPIRE against the environmental stresses of maritime environments.”
 L3Harris is also delivering VAMPIRE systems to the U.S. Army . Separately, the company unveiled its Wraith Shield™ software earlier this year, which provides a radio-as-a-sensor capability to defeat small drones and can be incorporated with VAMPIRE and Drone Guardian® systems to deliver layered defense against UxS threats.

 Featured Capabilities 
 VAMPIRE™ C-UAS Precision Strike & ISR Weapons System
 L3Harris’ Vehicle-Agnostic Modular Palletized ISR Rocket Equipment is a portable kit that can be installed on most vehicles with a cargo bed for launching of APKWS or other laser-guided munitions.
 Counter-Unmanned Systems (C-UxS)
 L3Harris leads in unmanned, autonomous systems and offers comprehensive solutions to counter threats on land, sea, and air. 
 Drone Guardian® Counter-UAS Protection
 Drone Guardian is an operationally proven counter-UAS system that autonomously detects, tracks and identifies drone threats using multi-sensor correlation, open integration and layered defeat options.
 WESCAM® MX®-10 RSTA, Independent Stabilized Sighting System
 The WESCAM MX-10 RSTA EO/IR modular sighting system – ideal for surveillance and reconnaissance, and target acquisition missions from amphibious, armored combat and reconnaissance vehicles.
